definitions.gloss: atmospheric pressure; air pressure; barometric pressure
definitions.explanation: The pressure exerted by the weight of the atmosphere. Used in weather forecasts and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{低|てい}→低：03961_tei⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: Atmospheric pressure is low at the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I get headaches from changes in air pressure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: When a typhoon approaches, the atmospheric pressure drops.

examples.japanese: {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急激|きゅうげき}な→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
examples.english: A sudden change in atmospheric pressure made me feel unwell.

notes:
Weather terms:
- ⟦{高|こう}{気圧|きあつ}→高気圧：14808_koukiatsu⟧ (high pressure system — brings clear weather)
- ⟦{低|てい}{気圧|きあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧ (low pressure system — brings clouds/rain)
- {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧ (pressure trough)
- {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (pressure change)

Units:
- hPa (ヘクトパスカル) — standard unit
- 1{気圧|きあつ} = 1013.25 hPa (standard atmospheric pressure)

Health:
- {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧ (weather-related headaches)
- ⟦{気象病|きしょうびょう}→気象病：noentry⟧ (meteoropathy — illness affected by weather)

Scientific terms:
- ⟦{大気圧|たいきあつ}→大気圧：noentry⟧ (atmospheric pressure — formal)
- ⟦{気圧計|きあつけい}→気圧計：noentry⟧ (barometer)
